selection.selectionSplit: dev selection core only; final test is held out

tier0.sample: fixed tier0-dev and tier0-test manifest IDs
tier0.timing: shared measured local and Guard components; reconstructed stage sums, not live end-to-end cloud latency

pricing.format: JSON subset of YAML 1.2; parsed without an additional dependency
pricing.label: Illustrative planning assumptions, not verified provider invoice prices
pricing.tokenEstimate: Input content is counted offline with Google's SDK-selected Gemini tokenizer and a labelled Llama 3.1 BPE proxy for Muse Spark. Server framing is unknown; headline projections assume zero extra framing, with sensitivity reported separately. No remote countTokens or generation requests.
pricing.outputProjectionLabel: Per-item-category answer and reasoning lengths are assumptions, not observed cloud output. Their sum never exceeds the shared output cap.

muse-spark.reservationNote: Conservative additional 65,536 thinking tokens; provider compatibility does not expose a separate thinking cap. Answer cap remains 384. Retain reservation when usage is absent.

gemini.reservationNote: Conservatively reserve the model's entire 65,536 output-token ceiling in addition to the 384 answer cap for internal thinking. No thinking traces are requested.
gemini.selectionReason: Stable exact ID; later Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite and 3.6+ models ignore temperature. This pin preserves the requested temperature=0 setting.

pricing.budgetSemantics: CLOUD_BUDGET_USD caps usage priced at these explicit assumptions plus all outstanding worst-case reservations. Actual provider invoice cost is unknown unless a response exposes a monetary cost; never relabel metered estimates as an invoice. Every dispatched failed/unknown attempt keeps its reservation.

policy.selectionSplit: dev selection core only; final test is held out

receipts.verificationScope: Pinned local Ed25519 signatures, signed hash links and retained redacted payload hashes. Does not prove remote delivery or prevent simultaneous rollback of ledger and signed head.
receipts.auditTiming: Full prefix and payload audit at open and close; each append verifies only the new receipt/snapshot, cached file identity and signed head

notes: Tier 0 costs are assumptions; no cloud generation or cloud quality measured.
Tier 0 latency is a reconstructed sum of measured local/retrieval/Guard components; deferred cloud total latency is pending.
Each model and pipeline is reported separately; no averaging 4B, 8B and 12B.
Meta access remains paused; no access probe is made.
Provider invoice USD stays unknown when usage has no monetary cost.
Classification thresholds are trained on dev only; final test is held out.
Corrected costs are cloud fees only, directly averaged over item-level routed payload token counts. Local hardware allowance is separate.
Gemini uses the offline tokenizer selected in Google’s SDK; Muse Spark uses a labelled Llama 3.1 proxy. Neither is a measured provider invoice, and hidden server framing remains unknown.
Output and reasoning lengths vary by category and are explicitly assumed.
The 200-item random local grading audit and the original 60-item slice are distinct; no routing thresholds were retuned.
